source: coverage inventory 2026-11-18 (docs/ADAPTIVE_SYSTEM.md); reasons are facts as of that date and are not recomputed

nba: Deep members (torch/keras MLPs) are skipped in the trainer environment and unverified; the combiner uses the other members
nhl: Deep members (torch/keras MLPs) are skipped in the trainer environment and unverified; the combiner uses the other members
NHL challengers are fitted but candidate_forecasts (CF) holds 0 rows: a shots data gap, so challengers are not recorded
ncaab: Adaptive learning (adaptive-v1 is not used) is not implemented for NCAAB and the served forecasts stay frozen (frozen decision 2026-11-17). Prospective challenger learning is implemented (weekly refits of the frozen calibration and sigmas, C1-C4) but not scheduled: no job is installed, so rows exist only after a manual learning_run
nfl: Adaptive learning is not implemented for NFL and the served forecasts stay frozen (sealed activation). Prospective challengers (winner Elo K and home-advantage variants, points eta variants from the existing grids) are implemented but not scheduled: no job is installed, so rows exist only after a manual learning_run. Evidence is expected to stay insufficient this season (about 17 games a week)
soccer: Adaptive learning is not implemented for soccer and the sealed models are served without retraining. Prospective spec challengers on the served Poisson goals joint (Dixon-Coles, 180-day decay, league dispersion) are implemented but not scheduled: no job is installed, so rows exist only after a manual learning_run. Priced for 1X2, match goals, team goals and BTTS at the served half and whole lines only (quarter lines are skipped and counted); double chance and draw no bet are derived from the 1X2 rows at read time
